item: issue #26 F08: non-forward walking looks like a moonwalk

after.file: local pnpm build of branch wip/i26-gait with the review fix (not committed; the orchestrator regenerates dist)

afterBeforeReviewFix.file: local pnpm build of wip/i26-gait at dd230a8 (gait also applied to falling actors)

pixiGait.check: scripts/coast-sample-test.mjs step 'F08 gait' (runs in pnpm test:coast-animation). Player aim E (0 rad), synthetic copies of the live batch, 16 view frames at 0.05 s and 112 px/s per case; body direction and frame read from the body texture.

before.negativeControl: the only negative control for this step: the same, unchanged step run against the e9cbaa5 build; the step itself does not re-derive the old rule from the new build
before.animationGroup: 6/7 passed, only F08 gait failed; errors 0; external requests 0
before.firstFailure: backpedal: body E on all 16 frames with the forward cycle (frame runs 1,2,3,4,1; expected 3,0,1,0,3)
before.strafes: not reached by the assertions (the step stops at the backpedal failure); the before strip, read from the body texture ahead of the assertions, shows body E f1-f4 for both strafes

reviewFixFallKeepsAim.issue: the death batch still carries the velocity of the step the actor died in, so a player killed mid-strafe drew the first fall frame on the hip-turned SE body, then jumped to E
reviewFixFallKeepsAim.fix: src/coast-view/scene.ts syncActor passes `speed > 5 && a.alive` as gait's moving flag, so the dead and the falling face the aim as before F08
reviewFixFallKeepsAim.beforeFix: F08 gait step failed on the dd230a8 build (animation group 6/7): falling frames were SE f0, then E f0
reviewFixFallKeepsAim.afterFix: passed: falling frames E f0, E f0

images.note: Strips (1034x988) are crops of the composited view target captured in a 1280x720 viewport, one crop per walk phase. The two full screenshots are 1280x720 pages of the new build.

pixi.before: 2/4 passed against the e9cbaa5 src/coast-view/input.ts: aim stays null with only the move stick (expected PI/2) and after releasing the aim stick (expected 0)

phaser.check: scripts/mobile-test.mjs step 'move stick alone turns the player toward the walk direction' (844x390 landscape, CDP touch)
phaser.after: passed: rotation PI while walking west, PI/2 while walking south, kept after release, magazine unchanged
phaser.before: failed on the e9cbaa5 build: 'west 0' (the player keeps facing east while walking west)
